Name: HAS_Tweaks - Health and Stamina Tweaks (regeneration and more)
Author: Svard
Description:
[size=4][center]﻿[b][/b][/center][/size][center][b][u][size=6]Health and Stamina Tweaks
[/size][/u][/b][size=5][u]With code from Zoryn's RegenMod[/u][/size][/center][size=4]

Health and Stamina Tweaks is yet another regeneration mod that does a little bit more. On top of providing the basic functions of the standard regen mod, it also allows the modification of one's max health and stamina values with some additional customization for each area.

I initially was going based on Hammurabi's old Regeneration mod as it already had a lot of the options I wanted -- and more. However, there were a lot of functions that were either very niche or not necessary at all. I'm also still a novice at coding, and couldn't get his code to work with the current version of SMAPI. So I used code from [url=https://github.com/Zoryn4163/SMAPI-Mods/tree/master/RegenMod]Zoryn's mod[/url] instead and added my own bits to get more functionality.

[/size][center][size=4][b]Source code:[/b] [url=https://github.com/SvardXI/HAS_Tweaks]https://github.com/SvardXI/HAS_Tweaks[/url]﻿
[/size][left][size=4]This code is open source under GPL 3.0, so you are free to use, modify and release modifications as you please.
[size=4]Special thanks also to PathosChild for SMAPI and for updating Zoryn's RegenMod.[/size][/size][/left][/center][left]
